description:
Create a new Metadata Primitives benchmark to test cross-platform catalog/schema
introspection performance. This benchmark tests INFORMATION_SCHEMA views, SHOW commands,
and DESCRIBE operations that are essential for data discovery and tooling integration.

Unlike Read/Write/Transaction primitives that test data operations, this benchmark
focuses on metadata operations that are critical for:
- Data catalog integration
- Schema discovery tools
- IDE autocomplete performance
- BI tool connectivity
- Data governance workflows
